top_signals.title: US to open two new military bases in Greenland, sources say
top_signals.summary: The U.S. plans to re-establish a Cold War-era military base in southern Greenland and set up another on the east coast, according to sources.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Circle lands $100 million from Binance to ramp up global USDC expansion
top_signals.summary: Binance will invest $100 million in stablecoin issuer Circle and agreed to promote the stablecoin issuer's flagship USDC on its platform.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: AI is set to help cyber attackers much more than defenders, says UK official
top_signals.summary: Dave Chismon, the NCSC’s chief technology officer for architecture, said in a blog post that the imbalance in AI means cyberattacks would likely grow as automated defenses struggle to keep pace.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
